# ByeBulky

> Verified ways to get rid of big stuff, city by city. A directory of real options for getting rid of couches, mattresses, furniture and appliances: City bulk and mattress pickup, charities that pick up, drop-off spots, furniture banks and paid haulers.

Every listing comes from the organization's own website or an official government page, links to its sources, and shows the date it was last verified. When a source doesn't state something, the listing says "Not stated, check with them". ByeBulky publishes no reviews or ratings.

## Cities

- [Boston Bulk Item Pickup & Junk Removal Guide (2026)](https://byebulky.com/boston/): Every verified way to get rid of a couch, mattress, furniture or appliance in Boston: City pickup, ReStore, furniture banks and haulers, with sources.
- [Brookline MA Bulky Item Pickup: $20 Items, $65 Mattresses](https://byebulky.com/brookline/): Brookline bulky item pickup: $20 furniture, $30 appliances and electronics, $65 per mattress. Book a week ahead online. Rules, Tuesday pickups, sources.
- [Cambridge MA Bulky Item & Furniture Pickup: 2026 Rules](https://byebulky.com/cambridge/): Cambridge takes 1 furniture item a week free with trash. Appliances need a $25 permit; mattresses go through UTEC at $45 each. All sourced.
- [Newton MA Bulky Item Pickup: $20 Fee, Mattress & Dump Rules](https://byebulky.com/newton/): Newton bulky item pickup is $20 per item, mattresses $60 curbside or $35 drop-off, appliances $25 or free at the Rumford Ave center. All sourced.
- [Quincy MA Bulky Item & Furniture Pickup: 2026 Rules & Options](https://byebulky.com/quincy/): Quincy takes 2 furniture items a week free at the curb. Mattresses: free South Shore Recycle pickup (8 units or fewer). Appliances: call ahead. All sourced.
- [Somerville Bulky Item & Furniture Pickup: 2026 Rules](https://byebulky.com/somerville/): Somerville takes 2 furniture items a week free with trash. Mattresses need a $55 sticker and a 311 appointment; appliances a $25 sticker. All sourced.

## Item guides

- [Get Rid of a Fridge, AC, or TV in Boston (Free Pickup + Donation)](https://byebulky.com/boston/appliances/): Boston picks up fridges, ACs, and TVs free by appointment. Mass Save also gives a no-cost pickup and $75 for a working fridge. Rules, donations, haulers.
- [How to Get Rid of a Box Spring in Boston (Free & Paid)](https://byebulky.com/boston/box-spring/): Box springs are banned from Massachusetts trash. Free City of Boston pickup by appointment, apartment options, haulers from $65, and who takes donations.
- [Couch Removal & Sofa Disposal in Boston: Free and Paid Options](https://byebulky.com/boston/couch/): Boston lets you put furniture out with regular trash. Here's how it works, which charities take sofas, and paid pickup options, with sources.
- [Does Goodwill Take Furniture in Boston? Accepted vs Rejected](https://byebulky.com/boston/donation-rules/): Goodwill donations accepted in Boston? Only small furnishings one person can carry—no large furniture or mattresses. Habitat, Salvation Army and more, quoted.
- [How to Get Rid of a Hot Tub in Boston: Removal Cost and Prep](https://byebulky.com/boston/hot-tub/): Boston's City pickup doesn't list hot tubs. Hot tub removal options, prices (LoadUp from $875 nationally, $910 on its Boston list), and what to do first…
- [City of Boston Mattress Removal: Book a 311 Pickup & Prices](https://byebulky.com/boston/mattress/): Mattresses are banned from Massachusetts trash. Book Boston's curbside mattress pickup (6 units or fewer) or use a hauler in 7+ unit buildings.
- [How to Get Rid of Old Paint in Boston: Latex Trash + Oil Drop-Off](https://byebulky.com/boston/paint/): Get rid of old paint in Boston for free: dry latex and trash it (lid off); take oil-based to City Zero Waste Day (Nov 21, 2026). Limits and ID rules quoted.
- [How to Get Rid of a Piano in Boston: Donate, Give Away, Remove](https://byebulky.com/boston/piano/): Getting rid of a piano in Boston: donate it (CMCB grand pianos, PianosForEducation pickup), list it free to a taker, or pay for removal (LoadUp from $430).
- [Free Propane Tank Disposal in Boston: Grill Tank Drop-Offs](https://byebulky.com/boston/propane-tank/): Where to get rid of a propane tank for free in Boston: City Zero Waste Day (empty or full; next Nov 21, 2026) or Blue Rhino recycling. Never in the trash.
- [Boston Sept. 1 Move-Out: Getting Rid of Furniture & Mattresses](https://byebulky.com/boston/september-1-move-out/): Moving out of a Boston apartment on Sept 1? City rules for curbside furniture, mattress and fridge appointments, plus donation pickups that book weeks ahead.
- [Brookline Appliance Pickup: $30 Town White Goods Collection](https://byebulky.com/brookline/appliances/): Brookline picks up fridges, stoves, ACs and TVs for $30 per item on Tuesdays if you're on Town trash service. How to book, Mass Save $75, donations.
- [Brookline Box Spring Disposal & Pickup: $65 Town Recycling](https://byebulky.com/brookline/box-spring/): Brookline box spring disposal: $65 per mattress or box spring through the Town's bulky pickup, collected Tuesdays. How to book, who qualifies, other options.
- [Brookline Couch Removal & Sofa Disposal: $20 Town Pickup](https://byebulky.com/brookline/couch/): Brookline couch disposal: $20 Town bulky pickup booked a week ahead, curbside only. Who takes sofa donations, and paid in-home couch removal, sourced.
- [Brookline Mattress Disposal & Pickup: $65 Town Recycling](https://byebulky.com/brookline/mattress/): Brookline mattress disposal: $65 per mattress or box spring through the Town's bulky pickup, collected Tuesdays. How to book, who qualifies, other options.
- [Cambridge Appliance Pickup: $25 Permit for Fridges, ACs, TVs](https://byebulky.com/cambridge/appliances/): Cambridge picks up fridges, washers, ACs and TVs over 20" with a $25 permit ($20 age 62+). How to book, what's free, and the Mass Save $75 fridge option.
- [How to Get Rid of a Box Spring in Cambridge, MA ($45 UTEC)](https://byebulky.com/cambridge/box-spring/): Box springs are banned from Massachusetts trash. Cambridge's UTEC curbside pickup costs $45 each; apartment haulers, drop-offs and donation rules.
- [Cambridge Couch Removal & Sofa Disposal: Free Curbside Pickup](https://byebulky.com/cambridge/couch/): Cambridge couch disposal: one free furniture piece a week at the curb on trash day. Where to donate a sofa and who removes it from inside, sourced.
- [Cambridge Mattress Removal & Pickup: $45 UTEC Fee, How to Book](https://byebulky.com/cambridge/mattress/): Cambridge mattress pickup now costs $45 per mattress or box spring, booked with UTEC. How to schedule, what's refused, and paid or donation alternatives.
- [Newton Appliance Pickup: $25 Whitegoods, Free RRC Drop-Off](https://byebulky.com/newton/appliances/): Newton picks up fridges, washers, ACs and TVs for $25 per item, or drop them free at the Resource Recovery Center (TVs $25). Mass Save $75, donations.
- [Newton MA Box Spring Disposal: $60 Pickup or $35 Drop-Off](https://byebulky.com/newton/box-spring/): Newton box spring disposal: $60 per item curbside pickup or $35 drop-off at the Rumford Ave Resource Recovery Center. How to pay, schedule and set out.
- [Newton Couch Removal & Sofa Disposal: $20 Bulky Item Pickup](https://byebulky.com/newton/couch/): Newton, MA couch disposal: pay $20 online for City bulky item pickup, 150 lb limit, a sectional counts as one item. Donation and in-home removal options.
- [Newton MA Mattress Disposal: $60 Pickup or $35 Drop-Off](https://byebulky.com/newton/mattress/): Newton mattress disposal: $60 per item curbside pickup or $35 drop-off at the Rumford Ave Resource Recovery Center. How to pay, schedule and set out.
- [Quincy Appliance Pickup: Fridge, Washer, TV (Call 855-533-3400)](https://byebulky.com/quincy/appliances/): Quincy picks up stoves, fridges, washers, dryers and TVs at the curb when you call (855) 533-3400. DPW Yard drop-off (no fridges), Mass Save $75, donations.
- [Quincy Box Spring Pickup: Free South Shore Recycle Booking](https://byebulky.com/quincy/box-spring/): Quincy box spring pickup is free through South Shore Recycle for homes and buildings with 8 units or fewer. How to book, curbside rules and paid options.
- [Quincy Couch Removal & Sofa Disposal: Curbside, No Call](https://byebulky.com/quincy/couch/): Quincy, MA couch disposal: City curbside takes two bulky items a week, sofas included, no call needed. Where to donate a sofa and who carries it out.
- [Quincy Mattress Pickup: Free South Shore Recycle Booking](https://byebulky.com/quincy/mattress/): Quincy mattress pickup is free through South Shore Recycle for homes and buildings with 8 units or fewer. How to book, curbside rules and paid options.
- [Somerville Appliance Pickup: $25 Sticker, Free TV Pickup](https://byebulky.com/somerville/appliances/): Somerville picks up fridges, washers, stoves and ACs with a $25 white goods sticker, and TVs and monitors free via 311.
- [How to Get Rid of a Box Spring in Somerville ($55 Sticker)](https://byebulky.com/somerville/box-spring/): Somerville charges $55 per box spring, counted separately from the mattress. Sticker, 311 scheduling, 2-item weekly limit, apartment and donation options.
- [Somerville Couch Removal & Sofa Disposal: Free City Pickup](https://byebulky.com/somerville/couch/): Somerville couch disposal: free City curbside pickup, two furniture pieces a week on trash day. Where to donate a sofa and who removes it from inside.
- [Somerville Mattress Removal & Pickup: $55 Sticker, 311 Options](https://byebulky.com/somerville/mattress/): Mattress removal Somerville: City $55 sticker + 311 appointment (since Feb 1, 2026), who qualifies, what's refused, and other pickup options — each with a…
